post.description: This API lets you make payouts to bank accounts and mobile money wallets

sourceCurrency.description: The currency which is used to fund the  payout

destinationCurrency.description: The currency in which the recipient will be receiving funds

amount.description: The value that is to be transferred from the source currency wallet.

business.description: The unique Identifier of the parent business or sub account

customerReference.description: The transaction's unique identifier on your system.

firstName.description: The first name of the beneficiary .

lastName.description: The last name of the beneficiary.

type.description: The type of beneficiary receiving the payout, which might be either an individual or a corporation.

accountHolderName.description: The name of the beneficiary on the bank account

accountNumber.description: The account number of the beneficiary

mobileMoneyCode.description: This is a unique Identifier of the beneficiary mobile money wallet

country.description: This should be the code of country according to ISO 3166-1 Alpha 2.This is required for payouts where the destination currency is not NGN.

bankCode.description: The bank code of the beneficiary's bank

bankSwiftCode.description: The bank swift code of the beneficiary

sortCode.description: The bank sort code of the beneficiary. This is required to process a payout to a bank in the United kingdom

registrationNumber.description: This field only applies to a EUR/GBP corporate beneficiary. A government institution provides the company's unique registration number.

country.description: The code of country according to ISO 3166-1 Alpha 2

document.description: The document needed to process the transaction

type.description: type of ID document e.g International Passport

issuedCountryCode.description: The country that issued the document.Should  be in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 – two-letter country codes format(NG)

issuedBy.description: The government agency in charge of issuing the document.

expirationDate.description: The expiration date on the document("YYYY-mm-dd")

paymentDestination.description: This is the type of account you want to send your payments to e.g bank account, mobile money wallet

paymentScheme.description: The payment scheme relevant to the destination currency and region e.g sepa

quoteReference.description: This is the reference generated when the source currency is compared against the destination currency.

post.description: This API lets you create a single virtual account

businessId.description: The unique Identifier of the business. The business ID of the merchant

subAccountId.description: The unique identifier of the subaccount. The business ID of subaccount

accountType.description: The Virtual account type e.g corporate or individual

firstName.description: The first name of the customer.This is required when requesting an individual virtual account.

lastName.description: The last name of the customer.This is required when requesting an individual virtual account and optional when requesting a virtual account in NGN.

businessName.description: The business name of the company requesting the virtual account.This is only required when requesting a corporate virtual account.

bvn.description: Bank verification number. This is a compulsory requirement that only applies to requests for NGN virtual account creation.

birthDate.description: The birthdate of the customer(YYYY-MM-DD ).This is required when requesting an individual virtual account in EUR or GBP

address.description: The address of the customer . This is required when requesting an individual virtual account in EUR or GBP.

country.description: The code of country according to ISO 3166-1 Alpha 2

document.description: The means of identification of the customer . This is required when requesting an individual virtual account in EUR or GBP.

type.description: type of ID document e.g International Passport

issuedCountryCode.description: The country that issued the document.Should  be in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 – two-letter country codes format(NG)

issuedBy.description: The government agency in charge of issuing the document.

issuedDate.description: The date the document was issued("YYYY-mm-dd")

expirationDate.description: The expiration date on the document("YYYY-mm-dd")

occupation.description: The occupation of the customer.This is when requesting an individual virtual account in EUR or GBP

businessCategory.description: The type of business e.g Consultant, Advertising Government Agency. Financial Institution/Investment Bank etc.This field only applies to corporate EUR/GBP virtual accounts

additionalInfo.description: More information about the customer This parameter is completely optional when requesting a corporate virtual account in either EUR or GBP, and it is not allowed when requesting an NGN virtual account.

meansOfId.description: The customer's means of identification which should be a valid government ID e.g voters card, driving license.This can be a File Upload or URL link to the document.This field only applies to individual EUR/GBP virtual accounts

utilityBill.description: Electricity bills, water bills or any detailed invoice showing the usage of a service. This can be a File Upload  or URL link to the document. This field only applies to individual EUR/GBP virtual accounts

reason.description: The reason for requesting a virtual account.This field only applies to corporate EUR/GBP virtual accounts

paymentFlowDescription.description: The countries payments are coming from and going to, The general purpose of these payments,Customer categories of the business etc.This field only applies to corporate EUR/GBP virtual accounts

monthlyVolume.description: This is the committed transaction volume multiplied by the number of days in the relevant month. This field only applies to corporate EUR/GBP virtual accounts

entityName.description: This is the legal name of the business or company.This field only applies to corporate EUR/GBP virtual accounts

attachments.description: This can be a single document, a list of documents, or a list of URLs to the documents.This field only applies to corporate EUR/GBP virtual accounts

channel.description: The bank of the virtual account
